svg.text: Serial: 92-MV-4410-XQ — Batch LM-250-XQN7 — Recipient: Lumina Labs, Floor 4
Use only with supervision of a qualified optician. Not intended for under-3 years.
Store below 25°C. Net weight 250ml. Part no. LM-250-XQN7 — dead serial only.
Sample label image for zoom testing — the fine print is meant to be hard to read at 100%.
1. Shake well before use. 2. Point the lens at unreadable text. 3. Adjust zoom with Alt + scroll wheel.
4. Choose circle, square, rounded or wide shape. 5. Boost contrast when text is faint. 6. Pin the lens to read hands-free.
Expiry date: 2028-06-30 · GTIN 0614141 23456 7 · Made in Region 9 · QA stamp: L-4410/XQ
